description: List per-context commit statuses for a full 40-character SHA. Bounded by page (default 1) and limit (default 30, lowered to the instance ceiling when that is lower; a limit above a known ceiling is refused). Returns the envelope {sha, statuses, page, limit, count, has_next, total_count}; has_next true means a further page may exist, so re-issue the call with page incremented. total_count is present only when Forgejo reports X-Total-Count. Combined aggregate stays on forgejo://repo/{owner}/{repo}/commit/{sha}/status. Commit statuses are CI context checks, not Actions workflow runs (list_workflow_runs).
name: get_commit_statuses
